fields.name: PPIN
fields.description: {"value":"Private school identification number assigned by the Private School Survey (PSS).","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: NAME
fields.description: {"value":"Name of the school provided by the reporting agency.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: STREET
fields.description: {"value":"The reported address for the school. If no address is available on the directory file, the address fields are\nset to M. ","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: ZIP
fields.description: {"value":"The reported ZIP Code for the school. ","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: STFIP
fields.description: {"value":"The two-difit FiPS code of the state where the school is located.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: CNTY
fields.description: {"value":"The five-digit code that uniquely identifies all counties in the U.S.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: LOCALE
fields.description: {"value":"General geographic indicator that classifies the type of area where a school is located. Locale codes are based on a twelve-category framework that includes four primary classifications (City, Suburban, Town, and Rural) that each have three sub-types.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: CBSATYPE
fields.description: {"value":"CBSAType code that idenifies the location of a school relative to a CBSA. The indicator distinguishes between schools located in metropolitan, micropolitan, and non-CBSA area.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}
